text: Walking by the glass-walled room where people are deep in discussion and presentations, I feel a sense of curiosity, as if I’m a traveler glimpsing the world of ideas from the outside. In the next space, the vivid mural and the bold R+D symbols evoke the restless energy of innovation. I feel invigorated, surrounded by the pulse of collective intellect, and a little awed by how spaces shape our pursuit of knowledge. Here, I am both an observer and participant in the dance of progress.
